At a café and want a cute photo with your baby? Skip the awkward selfie 😂 I propped my phone up against a cup, switched to Cinematic video in 4K, put the exposure up and the S setting all the way down, then just hit record and played with Mila. She looked one way, so I looked the other. We cuddled, moved around, didn’t overthink it — and that’s when the cute moments happened. Afterwards I grabbed my favourite frames from the video and edited them using the 90s Summer effect in Instagram Stories. No tripod. No photographer. Just your phone, a coffee cup and a few minutes with your baby 🤍 Save this for your next café date. #iphonephotographytips #mumandbabyphotos #familyphotography #babyphotography #photographytips
